The provided text describes a scenario where users downloading pirated software have inadvertently installed a botnet. A botnet is a network of compromised computers controlled by a malicious actor. In this specific case, the malware uses these infected machines to launch Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, which aim to disrupt the normal traffic of a targeted server, making it inaccessible to users. While the text does not explicitly mention data encryption or ransom demands, the presence of a botnet constitutes a significant malware threat, as it compromises system integrity and can be used for various malicious activities beyond DDoS, such as spamming or further malware distribution.

The capital of France is Paris.
